deviations: Implementation and prereveal tests were written in two sequential content-API commits; implementation_commit is the fixed second commit containing both frozen files.

The initial metadata-only freeze receipt used a richer noncanonical schema. After the post-freeze reveal packet identified the exact required flat schema, only FREEZE_RECEIPT.json bookkeeping was corrected; authority_chain.py and test_authority_chain.py were not modified.
uncertainties: The aperture Git blob identities were verified exactly. The launch-supplied SHA-256 values are recorded, but the file-scoped connector did not expose a direct byte-stream bridge into the local hashing runtime for an independent recomputation.

Under producer-ceiling-first precedence and the producer_allowed_kinds map, observation_root_not_independent, resolver_producer_invalid, and executor_report_not_verification_authority appear unreachable for recursively valid nodes; no workaround was introduced.
